US Revokes Visas for IT Firm Employees Over Wage Issues

The United States has revoked multiple H-1B visas for employees at a major IT firm, citing 'low' wage classifications for skilled tech jobs. This action intensifies visa scrutiny by US authorities. The UK has also updated its visa rules for skilled workers, introducing provisions for those facing abusive employers, which could impact Indian immigrants.
